description: This Java source file defines a service class 'RouteService' responsible for calculating optimized routes between two geographical points. It interacts with the external OpenRouteService API to fetch routing data or provides a deterministic fallback when external calls are disabled or fail. The class utilizes Spring framework annotations for dependency injection and configuration, and it handles JSON processing with Jackson.

classes.name: RouteService
classes.description: Spring service component that provides route planning functionalities, including interaction with external mapping API and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getOptimizedRoute
methods.description: Fetches an optimized driving route between start and end points, either via external API or fallback.

methods.name: buildFallbackRoute
methods.description: Constructs a deterministic fallback route response for reliable UI and test behaviors when external API calls are unavailable or fail.
